FN-G3DN726-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 277
Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Sponsor: Senator Lance Bell
Economic Development
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 02/11/2026
Senate Bill 277 as introduced would provide for the formation and operation of decentralized
unincorporated nonprofit associations within the state, which could increase recording fee
receipts collected by probate judges and deposited into county general funds and filing fee
receipts collected by the Secretary of State (SOS) and deposited into Secretary of State Entity
Fund by undetermined amounts dependent upon the number of decentralized unincorporated
nonprofit associations formed in the state.
